characters.name: Warrior

characters.name: Wizard

characters.name: Ranger

characters.name: Monk
characters.description: Starts with Saradomin Strike. Weapons are 15% faster.

characters.name: Barbarian
characters.description: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. 20% more hitpoints.

characters.name: Ancient mage
characters.description: Starts with Ice Burst. Weapons cover 15% more area.
characters.unlock: Kill Ahrim the Blighted in Barrows

characters.name: Hunter
characters.description: Starts with a shortbow. Picks things up from 50% further away.

characters.name: Rogue
characters.description: Starts with bronze throwing knives. Finds 25% more coins and is luckier.

characters.name: Dragon slayer
characters.description: Starts with a bronze scimitar. Hits 15% harder.

characters.name: Nomad
characters.description: Starts with bronze throwing axes. Moves 5% faster and hits 10% harder.

characters.name: Menaphite
characters.description: Starts with Smoke Burst. Gains 15% more experience.

characters.name: Seer
characters.description: Starts with elemental runes. Effects last 25% longer.

characters.name: Berserker
characters.description: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Takes 0.5 less damage and hits back for 3.
characters.unlock: Kill Dagannoth Rex in Fremennik Province

characters.name: Obby mauler
characters.description: Starts with a Tzhaar-ket-om. Hits 10% harder and has 10% more hitpoints.

characters.name: Pirate
characters.description: Starts with bronze throwing knives. One more reroll a run, and 5% luckier.

characters.name: Pyromancer
characters.description: Starts with Fire Strike. Comes back to life once a run, like a phoenix.

characters.name: Shayzien soldier
characters.description: Starts with a bronze scimitar. Takes 0.5 less damage and heals 3 hitpoints a minute.

characters.name: Gladiator
characters.description: Starts with a dual macuahuitl. Weapons are 10% faster and hit 5% harder.

characters.name: Javelineer
characters.description: Starts with an eclipse atlatl. Projectiles fly 20% faster, and areas are 10% bigger.

characters.name: Vampyre hunter
characters.description: Starts with the Ivandis flail. Hits bosses 25% harder.

characters.name: Werewolf
characters.description: Starts with dragon claws. Heals off its hits now and then, and moves 5% faster.

characters.name: Godsword knight
characters.description: Starts with a godsword, and picks its hilt. Takes 1 less damage, but weapons are 5% slower.

characters.name: Armadyl ranger
characters.description: Starts with an Armadyl crossbow. Ranged weapons hit 10% harder, and projectiles fly 15% faster.
characters.unlock: Kill Kree'arra in God Wars Dungeon

characters.name: Elf archer
characters.description: Starts with a crystal bow. Moves 10% faster, and ranged weapons hit 5% harder.

characters.name: Gauntlet runner
characters.description: Starts with a crystal staff, and 30% weaker, but hits 2% harder with every level, up to 50% harder at level 41.

characters.name: Infernal champion
characters.description: Starts with a toxic blowpipe, the Inferno's favourite. Has 20% more hitpoints.

characters.name: TzHaar-Hur
characters.description: Starts with a Toktz-mej-tal, the obsidian staff. Areas are 15% bigger.

characters.name: Scammer
characters.description: Starts with bronze throwing knives. 50% more coins, and luckier. Trust them.

characters.name: F2P pker
characters.description: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Hits 10% harder and moves 5% faster.
characters.unlock: Kill Clan leader in East Varrock

characters.name: Durial321
characters.description: Starts with the Abyssal whip, but has 30% less hitpoints. Everyone plays him in Falador.

characters.name: LMS sweat
characters.description: Starts with Ice Burst. Weapons are 10% faster, and areas are 10% bigger.
characters.unlock: Kill AGS specer in Last Man Standing

characters.name: Castle Wars veteran
characters.description: Starts with a bronze 2h sword. Bandages heal 3 hitpoints a minute, and has 10% more hitpoints.
characters.unlock: Kill Flag carrier in Castle Wars

characters.name: Void knight
characters.description: Starts with a bronze scimitar, in the Void knight's equipment. Hits 10% harder.
characters.unlock: Kill Purple portal in Pest Control

weapons.name: Scimitar
weapons.description: Slashes at the closest enemy. Upgrades through the metals to dragon.

weapons.name: Abyssal whip
weapons.description: Evolved scimitar. Lashes on both sides, fast and far.

levels.name: Abyssal whip
levels.description: Evolved from the dragon scimitar with Piety.

weapons.name: Fire spells
weapons.description: Fires at the nearest enemy. Learns Bolt, Blast and Wave.

levels.name: Fire Blast
levels.description: Learns Fire Blast: +3 damage, small splash.

levels.name: Fire Wave
levels.description: Learns Fire Wave: +3 damage, bigger splash.

levels.name: Fire Wave
levels.description: Faster; waves pass through an enemy.

weapons.name: Flames of Zamorak
weapons.description: Evolved fire spells. Pillars of Zamorak's fire burst up under enemies all around you; bosses and elites are burned three times more.

levels.description: Evolved from Fire Wave with Augury.

weapons.name: Throwing knives
weapons.description: Throws knives at nearby enemies. Upgrades through the metals.

levels.name: Mithril knives
levels.description: Knives pass through one more enemy.

weapons.name: Toktz-xil-ul
weapons.description: Evolved throwing knives. Obsidian rings that go through everything.

levels.description: Evolved from rune knives with Obsidian armour.

weapons.name: Ice Burst
weapons.description: Bursts of ice around you that hurt and freeze.

weapons.name: Ice Barrage
weapons.description: Evolved Ice Burst. A huge freezing blast.

levels.name: Ice Barrage
levels.description: Evolved from Ice Burst with Protect from Melee.

weapons.name: Smoke Burst
weapons.description: Bursts of smoke around you that poison what they hit.

weapons.name: Shadow Burst
weapons.description: Bursts of shadow around you. What they hit takes 20% more damage for a while.

weapons.name: Blood Burst
weapons.description: Bursts of blood around you. Now and then a hit heals you by 2.

weapons.name: Smoke Barrage
weapons.description: Evolved Smoke Burst. A huge blast of smoke that poisons hard and long.

levels.name: Smoke Barrage
levels.description: Evolved from Smoke Burst with the Ancient sceptre.

weapons.name: Shadow Barrage
weapons.description: Evolved Shadow Burst. A huge blast of shadow; what it hits takes 30% more damage for a while.

levels.name: Shadow Barrage
levels.description: Evolved from Shadow Burst with the Ancient sceptre.

weapons.name: Blood Barrage
weapons.description: Evolved Blood Burst. A huge blast of blood. Now and then a hit heals you by 4.

levels.name: Blood Barrage
levels.description: Evolved from Blood Burst with Rapid Heal.

weapons.name: Saradomin Strike
weapons.description: Saradomin strikes random enemies around you.

levels.description: Strikes hit around the target too.

weapons.name: Undead Grasp
weapons.description: Evolved Saradomin Strike. Undead hands burst out of the ground and hold what they grab.

levels.description: Evolved from Saradomin Strike with the Book of the dead.

weapons.name: Two-handed sword
weapons.description: A heavy sweep in front of you. Upgrades through the metals to dragon.

weapons.name: Colossal blade
weapons.description: Evolved 2h sword. A huge sweep on both sides. Bosses and elites are hit again.

levels.description: Evolved from the dragon 2h sword with Dizana's quiver.

weapons.name: Shortbow
weapons.description: Shoots arrows at the nearest enemy. Upgrades through the woods to magic, the arrows through the metals.

levels.name: Willow shortbow
levels.description: Black arrows: they pass through an enemy.

levels.name: Magic shortbow
levels.description: Faster; arrows pass through one more enemy.

weapons.name: Dark bow
weapons.description: Evolved shortbow. Two heavy dragon arrows at a time, Descent of Dragons, that blow up where they hit.

levels.name: Dark bow
levels.description: Evolved from the magic shortbow with Rigour.

weapons.name: Throwing axes
weapons.description: Throws axes at the nearest enemy that bounce on from one to the next. Upgrades through the metals to dragon.

levels.name: Iron thrownaxe
levels.description: Axes bounce on to one more enemy.

levels.name: Adamant thrownaxe
levels.description: Axes bounce on to one more enemy.

levels.name: Dragon thrownaxe
levels.description: Axes bounce on to two more enemies.

weapons.name: Chain-hit axes
weapons.description: Evolved throwing axes. Morrigan's axes chain-hit through a crowd, bouncing on to up to nine more.

levels.name: Chain-hit axes
levels.description: Evolved from dragon thrownaxes with the Tome of fire.

weapons.name: Elemental runes
weapons.description: Runes circle you for a while, hitting whatever they pass and knocking it back.

levels.description: A water rune joins the air rune.
They go round faster, for longer.

weapons.name: Astral runes
weapons.description: Evolved elemental runes. Vengeance's runes circle you and never stop.
weapons.unlock: Kill Dagannoth Prime in Fremennik Province

levels.description: Evolved from elemental runes with Vengeance.

weapons.name: Scythe of Vitur
weapons.description: Sweeps a wide arc in front of you. Bosses and elites are hit three times.

weapons.name: Sanguine Scythe of Vitur
weapons.description: Evolved Scythe of Vitur. A wider sweep. Bosses and elites are hit three times, and every fourth sweep is Blood Harvest, which heals you.

levels.description: Evolved from the Scythe of Vitur with Chivalry.

weapons.name: Armadyl godsword
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is The Judgement, a huge hit.

weapons.name: Bandos godsword
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Warstrike: what it hits takes 25% more damage for 10s.

weapons.name: Saradomin godsword
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Healing Blade: heals you by half the damage it does, up to 3.

weapons.name: Zamorak godsword
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed sweep. Every third swing is Ice Cleave: what it hits is frozen in place.

weapons.name: Godsword
weapons.description: A heavy two-handed sweep. At level 2 you pick its hilt, and with it its special attack.

weapons.name: Ancient godsword
weapons.description: Evolved godsword. Every third swing is Blood Sacrifice: it hits everything around you and heals you.

levels.description: Evolved from a godsword with Piety.

weapons.name: Dragon claws
weapons.description: Four quick slashes at the closest enemy each time, the last the hardest.

levels.description: +2 damage a slash; also slashes behind you. +0.2 knockback.

weapons.name: Burning claws
weapons.description: Evolved Dragon claws. Four quick slashes each time, and every third set burns what it hits.

levels.description: Evolved from the Dragon claws with the Tome of fire.

weapons.name: Ivandis flail
weapons.description: Flails at the closest enemy. Vampyres and the undead are hit 50% harder.

levels.description: Flails a little faster and further.

weapons.name: Blisterwood flail
weapons.description: Evolved Ivandis flail. Vampyres and the undead are hit 50% harder, and pass the hit on to three more of their kind nearby.

levels.description: Evolved from the Ivandis flail with the Book of the dead.

weapons.name: Osmumten's fang
weapons.description: Fast, precise stabs at the closest enemy. Bosses and elites are hit twice.

weapons.name: Tzhaar-ket-om
weapons.description: A slow, crushing sweep that knocks enemies far back. Every fourth swing is Quake: what it hits is stunned.

weapons.name: Dragon warhammer
weapons.description: Heavy blows at the closest enemy. Every third is Smash: what it hits takes 30% more damage for 8s.

weapons.name: Elder maul
weapons.description: Evolved Dragon warhammer. A heavy sweep. Every third is Shockwave: it hits everything around you, and they take 30% more damage for 8s.

levels.description: Evolved from the Dragon warhammer with Protect from Melee.

weapons.name: Dinh's bulwark
weapons.description: A slow, heavy bash that hits everything around you, far out.

weapons.name: Dinh's blazing bulwark
weapons.description: Evolved Dinh's bulwark. A slow bash all around you. Every third is Shield Bash: it reaches further and burns what it hits.

levels.description: Evolved from Dinh's bulwark with Vengeance.

weapons.name: Dual macuahuitl
weapons.description: Very fast slashes on both sides of you.

weapons.name: Thunder khopesh
weapons.description: Quick slashes at the closest enemy. Every third is Thunderclap: it hits everything around you.

weapons.name: Twisted bow
weapons.description: Shoots the toughest enemy in range. The more hitpoints it has, the harder it hits: up to +150% on bosses.

weapons.name: Corrupted twisted bow
weapons.description: Evolved Twisted bow. Shoots the toughest enemy in range, up to +180% on bosses, and bosses and elites are hit again.

levels.description: Evolved from the Twisted bow with Rigour.

weapons.name: Bow of Faerdhinen
weapons.description: Fires crystal arrows at the nearest enemies that fly on through them.

levels.description: Arrows pass through two more enemies.
Fires one more arrow, a little faster.

weapons.name: Toxic blowpipe
weapons.description: Fires darts that leave venom in what they hit, hurting it every second. Goes for enemies without venom first, so it spreads.

weapons.name: Dragon hunter crossbow
weapons.description: Fires heavy bolts at the nearest enemy that pass through it. Bosses and elites are hit again.

weapons.name: Armadyl crossbow
weapons.description: Fires bolts at the nearest enemy that pass through it. One in five is enchanted: a ruby's takes a fifth of what's left of its hitpoints, a diamond's goes on through more, a dragonstone's burns.
weapons.unlock: Kill Kree'arra in God Wars Dungeon

weapons.name: Crystal bow
weapons.description: Fires crystal arrows at the nearest enemy. Each splits into three where it first hits, flying on through the enemies around it.

weapons.name: Corrupted bow (perfected)
weapons.description: Evolved crystal bow. Corrupted arrows split into five where they first hit, and each goes on through one more.

levels.description: Evolved from the crystal bow with the Graceful outfit.

weapons.name: Eclipse atlatl
weapons.description: Throws darts that pass through enemies and set what they hit burning.

weapons.name: Tumeken's shadow
weapons.description: Fires shadow blasts that splash. Triples your damage bonus for its hits.

levels.description: Bigger splash; blasts pass through an enemy.
Casts one more blast, a little faster.

weapons.name: Corrupted tumeken's shadow
weapons.description: Evolved Tumeken's shadow. Bigger blasts that pass through two enemies. 3.5x your damage bonus for its hits.

levels.description: Evolved from Tumeken's shadow with Augury.

weapons.name: Harmonised nightmare staff
weapons.description: Casts Fire Surge at the nearest enemy, quicker than any other staff.

levels.description: Bigger splash; surges pass through an enemy.

weapons.name: Eldritch nightmare staff
weapons.description: Evolved Harmonised nightmare staff. Each Fire Surge splits into three more where it first hits.

levels.description: Evolved from the Harmonised nightmare staff with the Amulet of glory.

weapons.name: Volatile Nightmare staff
weapons.description: Casts Immolate at the toughest enemy in range: slow, and the bigger the target, the harder it burns.
weapons.unlock: Kill The Nightmare in Hallowed Night

weapons.name: Inquisitor's mace
weapons.description: Crushing blows at the closest enemy, a quarter harder on the undead. Bosses and elites are hit again.
weapons.unlock: Kill The Nightmare in Hallowed Night

levels.description: +6 damage; also swings behind you. +0.2 knockback.

weapons.name: Sanguinesti staff
weapons.description: Casts blood blasts at the nearest enemy. One hit in six heals you for half its damage, up to 2 hitpoints.

levels.description: Faster; blasts pass through an enemy.

weapons.name: Holy sanguinesti staff
weapons.description: Evolved Sanguinesti staff. Blood blasts that splash. One hit in four heals you for half its damage, up to 3 hitpoints.

levels.description: Evolved from the Sanguinesti staff with Rapid Heal.

weapons.name: Kodai wand
weapons.description: Casts Water Surge at the nearest enemies, two at a time, with a splash.

weapons.name: Crystal staff
weapons.description: Casts crystal spells at the nearest enemy. Starts basic and grows: attuned at level 4, perfected at 7.

weapons.name: Toktz-mej-tal
weapons.description: Pulses of obsidian heat around you that leave the ground burning for a while, hurting whatever walks through.

levels.description: +3 damage; the ground burns for longer.

weapons.name: Blue moon spear
weapons.description: Ice crashes down on enemies around you, freezing them.

levels.description: Strikes one more enemy, a little more often.

passives.name: Protect from Melee
passives.description: Take less damage from every hit.

passives.name: Graceful outfit
passives.description: Move faster. Each level adds a piece.

passives.name: Amulet of glory
passives.description: Pick things up from further away.

passives.name: Vengeance
passives.description: Whatever hits you is hit back.
passives.unlock: Kill Dagannoth Prime in Fremennik Province

passives.name: Obsidian armour
passives.description: More hitpoints. Each level adds a piece.

passives.name: Book of the dead
passives.description: Freezes, poison and the rest last longer.

passives.name: Dizana's quiver
passives.description: One more of every projectile, whatever the pick's rarity.

passives.name: Chivalry
passives.description: Slashes and sweeps hit harder, and you can take more hits up close.

passives.name: Rigour
passives.description: Arrows, bolts and everything thrown hit harder.

passives.name: Augury
passives.description: Spells hit harder, and freezes, poison and the rest last longer.

passives.name: Ancient sceptre
passives.description: Auras and Ancient spells cover more ground.
